mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `position` (position_code, position_name, department_id, department_name, title, description, status, sort_order, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{positionCode}, #{positionName}, #{departmentId}, #{departmentName}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `position` SET position_code = #{positionCode}, position_name = #{positionName}, department_id = #{departmentId}, department_name = #{departmentName}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
